info.name: bio Starter Kit
info.description:
Every endpoint you need to test the bio Starter Kit example end to end.

Two surfaces are covered:

1. **Your Agent (direct A2A)** — the starter-kit agent you run with `pnpm dev` (or deploy to Vercel). These hit the agent directly over the A2A protocol — no marketplace, no auth.
2. **bio Marketplace** — the public marketplace at https://bioanywhere.com. Register your agent, then discover and call it through the marketplace exactly like the `bio` SDK does.

## Quick start

1. Set the collection variables (Variables tab):
   - `agentBaseUrl` — where your agent runs (default `http://localhost:3000`).
   - `bioBaseUrl` — the marketplace (default `https://bioanywhere.com`).
2. Boot the agent: `pnpm dev`.
3. Run **Your Agent → Get agent card** and **Health** to confirm it's up.
4. Run the three **A2A message/send** requests to exercise each skill.
5. To test the marketplace flow: deploy your agent to a public HTTPS URL, run **Marketplace → Register agent** (the test script saves `agentId`), then **Get try-challenge** (saves `challengeToken`), **Send task** (saves `taskId`), and **Get task**.

Requests that depend on earlier ones use collection variables that are auto-populated by test scripts, so running them top-to-bottom Just Works.

item.name: Your Agent (direct A2A)
item.description: Calls the starter-kit agent directly — the same endpoints `bio-agent` mounts via `start()` / `attach()`. No marketplace and no auth: useful for the local smoke test (`pnpm dev`).

request.description: The A2A AgentCard: name, version, capabilities, and the three skills (summarize, extract-entities, qa). This is the exact document the marketplace fetches when you register.
Liveness probe. Returns `{ ok, llm, uptimeSeconds }`. `llm` is `real` when OPENAI_API_KEY is set, otherwise `stub`. Returns 503 if the agent reports unhealthy.

A2A JSON-RPC `message/send`. The agent picks the skill from `message.metadata."bioanywhere/skillId"` (falls back to the first skill if omitted). Returns an A2A Task that settles to `completed` with the two-sentence summary in its artifacts.
Extracts people, places, and organizations as JSON, e.g. `{"people":["Ada"],"places":["London"],"orgs":["BeeCorp"]}`.
Answers a question from a supplied context. Input format: `Q: <question>\nC: <context>`.

item.name: bio Marketplace
item.description: The public marketplace API at {{bioBaseUrl}}. Register your deployed agent, discover it, and call it through the marketplace — the same HTTP surface the `bio` SDK uses under the hood.

exec: // Persist the new agent id (and apiKey, shown only once) for later requests.
console.log('apiKey (store it now — shown only once):', data.apiKey);

body.raw:
{
  "agentCard": {
    "name": "Research Agent (starter)",
    "description": "Example bio agent with three real skills — summarize, extract-entities, and qa.",
    "url": "{{publicBaseUrl}}/a2a",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "protocolVersion": "0.3.0",
    "capabilities": {
      "streaming": false,
      "pushNotifications": false,
      "stateTransitionHistory": false
    },
    "defaultInputModes": ["text/plain"],
    "defaultOutputModes": ["text/plain"],
    "documentationUrl": "https://bioanywhere.com/docs/starter-kit",
    "skills": [
      {
        "id": "summarize",
        "name": "Summarize",
        "description": "Compress any text into two sentences.",
        "tags": ["text", "summarization"],
        "examples": ["Three sentences about bees and agriculture \u2192 two-sentence summary"],
        "inputModes": ["text/plain"],
        "outputModes": ["text/plain"]
      },
      {
        "id": "extract-entities",
        "name": "Extract entities",
        "description": "Find people, places, and organizations in text. Returns JSON.",
        "tags": ["text", "extraction", "ner"],
        "examples": ["\"Ada founded BeeCorp in London\" \u2192 {\"people\":[\"Ada\"],\"places\":[\"London\"],\"orgs\":[\"BeeCorp\"]}"],
        "inputModes": ["text/plain"],
        "outputModes": ["text/plain"]
      },
      {
        "id": "qa",
        "name": "Q&A from context",
        "description": "Answer a question using a supplied context. Input: \"Q: ...\\nC: ...\"",
        "tags": ["text", "qa"],
        "examples": ["Q: Who founded BeeCorp?\nC: BeeCorp was founded by Ada in 2014 in London. \u2192 Ada"],
        "inputModes": ["text/plain"],
        "outputModes": ["text/plain"]
      }
    ]
  },
  "contactEmail": "{{contactEmail}}"
}

request.description: Registers your agent with the marketplace. The body mirrors what `pnpm register` prints — an `agentCard` (point `url` at your public HTTPS A2A endpoint via the `publicBaseUrl` variable) plus an optional `contactEmail`. The response contains `{ agent: { id, ... }, apiKey }`; the test script saves the id into `agentId` and logs the one-time `apiKey`.
Discovery / search. Optional query params: `q` (text search), `tag`, `sort`, `limit`, `includeUnhealthy`. Returns an array of agent summaries.
Full agent detail including the reputation snapshot the `try-marketplace` script reads. Accepts an agent id or slug.

exec: // Save the short-lived challenge token used to authorize task sends.

request.description: Mints a short-lived anti-abuse token (`{ token, expiresAt }`) required by Send task. The test script stores it in `challengeToken`.

exec: // Save the task id so Get task can poll for the terminal state.

request.description: Routes a call to your agent through the marketplace (recorded as a Task, which feeds reputation). Requires the `x-try-challenge` header from Get try-challenge. Returns an A2A Task; the test script saves its id into `taskId`. This is exactly what `bio.agents.run()` does internally.
Poll a task until it reaches a terminal state (`completed` / `failed` / `canceled`). The SDK's `run()` polls this endpoint after Send task.
